title: A genotype-phenotype screening system using conditionally immortalized immature dendritic cells
protocol: Collect 70–80% confluent cultured iniDCs by trypsinizing with TrypLE™ Express for 5 min at 37°C.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature and resuspend the cell pellet in freshly prepared TT medium for cell counting.
Adjust cell density to 2×105 viable cells/mL.
Seed 1 mL of cell suspension in TT medium into a 12-well plate.
Incubate overnight at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Remove medium and replace with 0.5 mL RPMI 1640.
Calculate volume of lentiviral particles for transduction: Volume = 0.3 MOI × cell number (2×105)/lentiviral titer (107TU/mL).
Thaw lentiviral particles on ice.
Mix lentiviral solution by pipetting up and down several times.
Drop 6 μL of lentiviral solution into the 0.5 mL iniDC culture.
Gently shake the plate to homogenize lentiviral particles in the culture.
Incubate the plate back in the cell culture incubator.
Six hours after adding lentiviral particles, complement medium with additional 1.5 mL TT medium.
Gently shake the plate to mix thoroughly.
Return the plate to the CO2 incubator.
Aliquot thawed and mixed lentiviral solution into single use quantities.
Store aliquoted solutions at -80°C.
Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles for stored solutions.
Replace the medium with fresh CG medium containing 10 μg/mL blasticidin at 48 hours post transduction.
Maintain the selection until blasticidin resistant cells recover to normal proliferation and reach confluency in a 12-well plate (yielding 2–5 × 10^5 cells).
Aspirate old media from confluent cells, add 500 μL prewarmed TrypLE™ Express reagent for 5 minutes.
Gently flush the cell layer with a P1000 pipette to confirm detachment.
Stop trypsinization with 500 μL prewarmed CG medium and transfer all content into a T25 tissue culture flask containing 10 mL complete DC growth medium supplemented with blasticidin.
Keep cells in the cell culture incubator until they reach 70%–80% confluency in the T25 flask.
Aspirate used media, add 3 mL prewarmed TrypLE™ Express reagent for 5 minutes to detach adherent cells.
Gently agitate the T25 flask to confirm cellular detachment and stop trypsinization with 5 mL of prewarmed CG medium.
Transfer all content into a 15 mL falcon tube, spin at 500 g at room temperature, remove supernatant, and resuspend pellet with 5 mL CG medium.
Pass the cell suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer to create a single cell suspension.
Count cellular density and adjust it to 1 × 10^6 cells/mL with CG medium containing 10 μg/mL blasticidin.
Prepare 96-well flat bottom tissue culture-treated microplates by adding 150 μL/well of CG medium containing 10 μg/mL blasticidin.
Transfer 1 mL single cell suspension to a FACS tube.
Add 1 μL DAPI solution (1 mg/mL) as a viability dye.
Proceed immediately to flowcytometric sorting using a BD FACSAria™ Fusion Cell Sorter with the help of an experienced operator.
Exclude debris and dead cells based on forward/side scatter characteristics and DAPI staining.
Seed healthy cells in 96-well flat-bottom tissue-culture plates prepared at one cell/well.
Keep the seeded cells in a cell culture incubator.
Observe plates regularly until visible clones arise.
Once clones have grown, discard the culture supernatant.
Add 50 μL/well TrypLE™ Express and incubate for 5 min at 37°C.
Gently flush the cell layer with a P200 pipette to confirm cellular detachment.
Stop trypsinization by adding 100 μL CG medium containing 10 μg/mL blasticidin.
Resuspend cells by pipetting up-and-down several times.
Transfer clones to a new 96-well plate.
Incubate further in a cell culture incubator until cells reach confluency.
Trypsinize confluent cells as described in step (c).
Stop the trypsinization with 150 μL CG medium containing 10 μg/mL blasticidin.
Resuspend cells by pipetting up-and-down several times.
Transfer 180 μL of cell suspension into a new 96-well plate for use as the assay plate.
Transfer the remaining cellular suspension into another 96-well plate to obtain the seed plate for preserving clones.
Supply 180 μL/well CG medium (containing 10 μg/mL blasticidin) to the seed plate.
Culture the assay plate overnight (>12 h).
Extract protein from cells in the assay plate after the culture period.
Perform WB detection of CAS9 nuclease expression.
Maintain blasticidin throughout the selection of single clones.
Use double the amount of Pen/Strep in the CG medium during sorting.
Visually detect clones 2 to 3 weeks after sorting.
Control evaporation and supplement with fresh CG medium if necessary.
Pause and freeze seed plates at −80°C if western blotting verification will take longer.
Collect clones by transferring cell suspensions into a 96-well V-shape plate.
Centrifuge the V-shape plates, discard supernatant, then resuspend cells in 100 μL FBS with 10% DMSO.
Freeze the resuspended cells immediately at −80°C.
Centrifugate the assay plate at 500 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant and invert the plate on a paper tissue to remove remaining liquid.
Add 100 μL of rapid WB protein preparation buffer per well.
Shake the plate on a shaker at maximum speed for 5 minutes.
Transfer the solution into a 96-well PCR plate.
Heat the samples to 100°C for 5 minutes.
Subject the denatured proteins to standard western blotting.
Detect CAS9 nuclease expression levels and β-actin as a loading control on the same blot.
Select clones that express a high level of CAS9 for further testing.
Incubate mouse monoclonal antibody to CAS9 at a dilution of 1:2,000 overnight (>12 h) at 4°C.
Incubate HRP mouse monoclonal antibody to β-actin at a dilution of 1:20,000 for 2 hours at room temperature.
Trypsinize selected CAS9-expressing clones as described in step 2c.
Stop the trypsin digestion with 150 μL CG medium.
Transfer all content to one well of a 6-well plate.
Supply 2 mL of CG medium containing 10 μg/mL blasticidin.
Maintain cells in an incubator until they reach 50%-70% confluency.
Trypsinize the clones in 6-well plates with 0.5 mL prewarmed TrypLE™ Express for 5 min at room temperature.
Gently flush the cell layer with a P1000 pipette to confirm cellular detachment.
Stop trypsin with 1.5 mL TT-DF medium.
Transfer 0.4 mL/well of cell suspension into a new 6-well plate for clone preservation.
Supply 1.6 mL/well CG medium (containing 10 μg/mL blasticidin) to the seed plate.
Transfer remaining cell suspension to another 6-well plate and supply with 1 mL TT-DF medium.
Let cells adapt in the incubator overnight (>12 h) for crRNA transfection.
Remove used medium from assay plates and replace with 2 mL fresh TT-DF medium.

Prepare the transfection mixture: add 5.5 μL of previously prepared 10 μM crRNA targeting murine Hmgb1 gene or non-targeting control gRNA #1, plus 5.5 μL of 10 μM tracrRNA to 100 μL serum-free RPMI 1640 medium.
Mix by pipetting up-and-down to get the guidance RNA transfection complex.
Add 10 μL of DharmaFECT 1 transfection reagent to 100 μL serum-free RPMI 1640 medium.
Gently mix by slowly pipetting up-and-down.
Gently mix solutions i and ii.
Incubate the mixed solution for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Add 200 μL of transfection mix dropwise into 2 mL CAS9-expressing iniDC culture.
Gently agitate the plate after adding the transfection mix.
Incubate transfected cells in a cell culture incubator for 72 hours.
Prepare homogenate from post-transfected cells with 250 μL/well of rapid WB protein preparation buffer.
Subject denatured proteins to WB detection of HMGB1 expression.
Use β-actin as a loading control in the WB detection.
Mix HMGB1 positive control and non-targeting control crRNAs according to the established protocol.
Apply the genetic screening protocol for genes of interest using selected clones with high CAS9 activity.
Transfect iniDC CAS9 cells with synthetic crRNA + tracrRNA to achieve specific gene knockout.
Confirm knockout of target genes by performing western blot or sequencing of the crRNA-targeted genomic DNA region.
Conduct an in vitro antigen cross-presentation assay to evaluate functional readouts using the OVA antigen.
Prepare verified iniDC CAS9 clones.
Expand cells according to the number of gRNAs that need to be transfected.
Seed 1×10^6 de-iniDC CAS9 cells/well in 2 mL DF medium into 6-well tissue-culture plates.
Prepare the trans-activating CRISPR RNA (tracrRNA).
Distribute tracrRNA into a 96-well plate at 100 μL/well.
Complement each well with equal quantities of specific gRNAs or non-targeting control gRNA.
Prepare DharmaFECT #1 transfection reagent.
Add 100 μL/well transfection reagent to the tracrRNA/gRNA complexes.
Incubate to obtain transfection-ready solutions.
Transfer 200 μL transfection mix to 1×10^6 iniDC CSA9 cells.
Calculate the total number of crRNAs to be transfected.
Prepare a pool of 10 μM tracrRNA (100 μL/well) in serum-free RPMI 1640 medium.
Dilute 495 μL of tracrRNA working stock in 9 mL serum-free RPMI 1640 medium.
Mix by pipetting up-and-down the diluted tracrRNA solution.
Distribute 100 μL/well to the corresponding wells in a new 96-well plate.
Add 5.5 μL of each specific crRNAs or non-targeting control crRNA to their corresponding wells containing tracrRNA.
Mix by pipetting up-and-down with a multichannel.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Prepare DharmaFECT 1 transfection reagent in equal amounts (900 μL of DharmaFECT 1 in 9 mL serum-free RPMI1640 medium).
Mix by pipetting up-and-down the prepared DharmaFECT 1 solution.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 100 μL of DharmaFECT 1 solution to each well containing 100 μL of the crRNA-tracrRNA mixture.
Mix by pipetting up-and-down.
Incubate for 20 min at room temperature.
Directly drop the 200 μL transfection mix to the designated 6-well plates.
Gently shake the plates to homogenize transfection efficacy across the well.
Incubate the plates in a cell culture incubator for 3 days.
Remove supernatant and replace with 2 mL of fresh DF medium.
Incubate at 37°C for 24 h to let the transfected cells recover from transfection.
On the 4th day post transfection, remove 1 mL of the medium from each well.
Detach cells by scraping with dispensable cell lifters.
Transfer the cellular suspension to a 96-deep-well plate.
Centrifuge the plate at 500 g for 5 min.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellets with 500 μL fresh DF medium for cell counting.
Adjust the concentration of viable cells to 5×10^5/mL using non-target crRNA transfected wells as a reference.
Seed cells in 96-well U-bottom tissue culture plates in 100 μL/well, equal to 5×10^4 cells/well, in replicate wells.
Normalize IL-2 values from crRNA-transfected samples to the average of non-target control crRNA-transfected cells.
Centrifuge plates for 5 minutes at 500 g after transfection in 6 well plates.
Remove supernatant and rapidly resuspend cell pellets with FBS containing 10% DMSO (100 μL/well).
Seal the plates and transfer directly to -80°C for storage.
Store cells at -80°C for a maximum of 12 months.
Perform phenotypic analysis of de-iniDCs expressing CRISPR-CAS9.
Stain de-iniDCs for surface co-stimulatory and maturation markers using flow cytometry.
Quantify major cytokine production via customized ELISAs.
Analyze pro-inflammatory cytokines including IL-1β, IL-12, TNFα, and IL-6.
Measure latent TGFβ levels linked with immunosuppressive functions.
Inhibit latent TGFβ release in the presence of DEX.
Stimulate de-iniDCs with LPS to induce cytokine release.
Indicate changes in cytokine abundance in cell culture supernatant as a measure of gene edited DC maturation and activation.
Monitor expression levels of surface markers CD69, CD80, CD86, CD83, and MHCII for phenotypic analysis.
Collect iniDC CAS9 cells and dilute to 5×10^5 cells/mL with DF medium.
Seed 1 mL of cell suspension/well in 12-well tissue culture plates (equal to 5×10^5 cells/well).
Incubate the plates at 37°C for 3 days to obtain differentiated de-iniDC CAS9.
Prepare a working solution of LPS by diluting the 1 mg/mL stock at a factor of 1/500 (final concentration 2 μg/mL).
Prepare a working solution of recombinant murine TNFα by diluting the 50 μg/mL stock at a factor of 1/1,000 (final concentration 50 ng/mL).
Dilute MCA205 lysate to a concentration equal to 5×10^5 cells/mL with DF medium.
Remove used medium and replace with 1 mL of fresh DF medium.
Replace the medium with 1 mL of working solution of LPS, recombinant TNFα, or MCA205 lysate as stimuli for DC maturation and activation.
Incubate the plates for 16 h at 37°C.
Collect all content of each well by scrapping cells from the well bottom using a plastic cell lifter.
Transfer the suspension into a 96-deep well round-bottom plate (which holds a maximum of 1.2 mL liquid in each well).
Spin the plate at 500 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate 500 μL of supernatant for cytokine quantification by ELISA.
Store samples at -20°C for up to one month or at -80°C for up to twelve months if not immediately used for ELISA.
Remove remaining supernatant from the cells.
Resuspend cell pellet in 200 μL cold PBS.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Transfer cell solution to a 96-well V-shape plate.
Stain cells with fluorescently-labeled antibody panel as per Table 1.
Perform flow cytometric analysis on stained cells.
Centrifuge cells at 500 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant by inverting and gently flicking down the plate, then remove all remaining liquid with a paper tissue.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL cold PBS containing 1/500 diluted Zombie UV viability dye.
Mix by pipetting up-and-down several times.
Incubate at 4°C in the dark for 25 min.
Add 100 μL FACS buffer containing 1/500 diluted Fc block antibody (anti-CD16/CD32).
Incubate for 10 min at 4°C in the dark.
Repeat step of resuspending cells with antibodies.
Resuspend the pellet with 100 μL antibody mixture diluted (in FACS buffer) according to Table 1 information.
Mix by pipetting up-and-down several times.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 150 μL FACS buffer per well and repeat step a.
Resuspend the pellet with 100 μL FACS buffer containing 10% PFA, mix by pipetting up-and-down several times.
Incubate for 20 min at 4°C in the dark.
Directly add 150 μL FACS buffer per well and repeat step a.
Resuspend the pellet with 200 μL FACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant by inverting and gently flicking down the plate.
Remove all remaining liquid by touching a paper tissue.
Repeat step f.
Resuspend the cells in 100 μL FACS buffer.
Conduct flow cytometry analysis.
Dilute an appropriate amount of ELISA capture antibody in 1× ELISA coating buffer according to the suggested dilution factor.
Add 100 μL/well of the capture antibody solution into 96-well high-binding assay plates.
Incubate at 4°C overnight (>12 h), or at room temperature for a minimum of 4 h.
Discard the liquid by inverting and gently flicking down the plate.
Remove all residual liquid by touching a paper tissue.
Add more than 250 μL of ELISA washing buffer.
Incubate for at least 30 seconds before discarding the liquid.
Repeat the washing step four times.
Discard the liquid and add 200 μL/well of ELISA diluent to block unspecific binding sites.
Incubate for a minimum of one hour at room temperature.
Reconstitute the lyophilized standard to the highest concentration with ELISA diluent.
Prepare a serial dilution with ELISA diluent in separate tubes.
Transfer standards and blank (ELISA diluent alone) to a 96-well V-shape plate or deep well plate for sample handling.
Aliquot mother solution into smaller volumes and store at -20°C for up to six months.
Dilute samples (supernatant) with ELISA diluent as suggested in Table 2.
Discard the ELISA diluent.
Remove residual liquid by tapping the plate upside down on a paper tissue.
Transfer 100 μL/well of blank, standards, and appropriately diluted samples to the designated wells.
Incubate the plates at room temperature on a plate shaker for 2 h at a speed of 40–80 rpm.
Discard the liquid.
Wash the plates 4 times.
Dilute an appropriate amount of biotinylated detection antibody in ELISA diluent according to the suggested dilution factor.
Remove residual liquid by tapping the plate upside down on a paper tissue.
Add 100 μL of diluted detection antibody solution to each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 h on a plate shaker at a speed of 40–80 rpm.
Discard the liquid.
Wash the plates 4 times.
Dilute avidin-HRP at a ratio of 1/1,000 with ELISA diluent.
Incubate the diluted avidin-HRP solution on the plate for 30 minutes at room temperature on a plate shaker.
Discard the avidin-HRP solution.
Wash the plates 5 times.
Add 100 μL/well of substrate after washing.
Incubate in the dark, continuously observing colorization.
Add 50 μL/well of stop solution to terminate the reaction when most concentrated standards turn dark blue.
Read absorbance at 450 nm as soon as possible.
Collect cultured iniDC cells and dilute to 5×10^5 cells/mL with DF medium.
Seed 1 mL cell suspension/well in 12-well tissue culture plates (equal to 1×10^5 cells/well) and incubate at 37°C for 3 days to obtain differentiated de-iniDC CAS9.
Prepare MCA205 cells in 75 cm² tissue culture flasks at 1×10^7 cells/20 mL D-BC medium for crizotinib treatment.
Let the prepared MCA205 cells adapt overnight (>12 h).
Prepare MCA205 cells in 75 cm² tissue culture flasks at 0.5×10^7 cells/20 mL D-BC medium for the DMSO control (untreated cells).
Stain MCA205 cells with CellTracker blue dye at a concentration of 10 μM in 20 mL serum-free DMEM for 60 minutes.
Replace staining solution with 20 mL D-BC containing 15 μM crizotinib or 0.15% DMSO.
Incubate cells under treatment conditions for 18–24 hours to yield more than 50% apoptotic cells.
Collect de-iniDCs and MCA205 cells for coculture.
Remove culture supernatant from de-iniDCs by aspirating with a vacuum pump.
Replace the removed supernatant with 1 mL fresh BC medium.
Detach adherent de-iniDCs using a cell lifter.
Flush the well bottom with a P1000 pipette and transfer all content into 1.5 mL centrifuge tubes or 96-deep well round-bottom plates.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Remove supernatant from de-iniDCs.
Resuspend each cell pellet in 0.5 mL DF medium for counting.
Adjust the density of de-iniDCs to 1×10^6 viable cells/mL.
Lift the MCA205 cell culture layer with a cell scrapper (Corning).
Flush the flask bottom with a 10 mL serological pipette.
Transfer all content into 50 mL falcon tubes.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Remove supernatant.
Resuspend each cell pellet with 5 mL DF medium for cell counting.
Adjust MCA205 density to 1×10^6 total cells/mL.
Mix 0.2 mL of de-iniDCs with 0.8 mL of MCA205 cells (1 to 4 ratio) in a tissue culture-treated 12-well plate.
Co-culture for 2 hours in a cell culture incubator.
Detach adherent cells using a cell lifter.
Flush the well bottom with a P1000 pipette and transfer all content into a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube or 96-deep well round-bottom plate.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 minutes at 4°C to collect the cells.
Proceed to surface staining with fluorescently labeled anti-mouse CD11c antibody.
Centrifuge cells at 500 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant by vacuum aspiration or inverting and gently flicking down the plate, remove residual liquid using a paper tissue.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 200 μL FACS buffer containing 1/1000 diluted Fc block antibody (anti-CD16/CD32).
Transfer the cell suspension to a 96-well V-shape plate and incubate for 10 minutes at 4°C in the dark.
Spin the plate at 500 g for 5 minutes at 4°C, discard the supernatant by inverting and gently flicking down the plate, remove residual liquid using a paper tissue.
Resuspend the pellet with 50 μL of APC-conjugated anti-CD11c antibody (1/100 diluted in FACS buffer), mix by pipetting up-and-down several times, incubate for 30 minutes at 4°C in the dark.
Add 150 μL of FACS buffer per well and repeat step iii).
Resuspend the pellet with 50 μL FACS buffer containing 10% PFA, mix by pipetting up-and-down several times, incubate for 20 minutes at 4°C in the dark.
Mix 200 μL FACS buffer per well.
Repeat step iii).
Repeat this step twice more to wash out residential PFA.
Resuspend with 100 μL FACS buffer.
Assess the sample by flow cytometry to quantify the proportion of CD11c and CellTracker double positive events as a proxy for DC mediated phagocytosis.
Collect well-differentiated de-iniDCs.
Dilute de-iniDCs to 5×10^5 cells/mL with DF medium.
Seed 100 μL cell suspension/well in 96-well tissue culture U-bottom plates (equal to 5×10^4 cells/well).
Let the cell suspension adapt in a 37°C incubator.
Prepare a 2×OVA working solution by adding 1 mL of the 100 mg/mL stock solution to 50 mL DF medium.
Prepare a 2×OVA peptide SIINFEKL working solution by serially diluting the stock solution to 4 ng/mL.
Add 100 μL of 2× OVA, 2× SIINFEKL, or non-antigen supplemented DF medium to each well containing de-iniDCs.
Gently shake the plate to mix the contents.
Incubate the cells for 4 h in the cell culture incubator.
Spin the plate at 500 g for 5 min, discard the supernatant containing OVA.
Add 200 μl/well RPMI 1640 medium (without any additives).
Spin the plate again at 500 g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Repeat this procedure once, i.e., 2 washes in total.
Prepare B3Z cells in DF medium at 5×10^5 cells/mL.
After the last centrifugation, discard the DC supernatant and add 200 μl B3Z cell suspension (in total 1×10^5 cells) to the DCs.
Incubate for 18 h at 37°C.
Spin the plates at 500 g for 5 min and gently aspirate 100 μl supernatant for the quantification of IL-2 secretion.
Prepare MCA205 cells in T175 tissue culture flasks at a confluency of 50%–75%, approximately 3-5×10^7/flask.
Detach cells as described and pass the cell suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL falcon tube to obtain single cell suspension.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature, discard supernatant and resuspend with 10 mL cold PBS, mix well.
Fill the falcon tube with cold PBS to 50 mL.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature, discard supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet with an appropriate volume of cold PBS to adjust the cell concentration to 5×10^6 cells/mL.
Shave the right flank of C57Bl/6 mice.
Subcutaneously inject 100 μL cell suspension under isoflurane anesthesia (day 0).
Collect iniDC CAS9 cells or any gene-modified iniDC CAS9 cells at day 3.
Adjust cell density to 1×10^6/mL in DF medium.
Place 40 mL cell suspension/150 mm tissue-culture dishes, equaling 4×10^7 cells/dish.
Remove used medium and replace with 40 mL of fresh DF medium containing lysate yield from 4×10^7 MCA205 cells at day 7.
Incubate for 2 h.
Collect de-iniDCs by scraping the cell culture layer with a plastic cell lifter.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min.
Resuspend the collected cells in 10 mL cold PBS and mix to homogeneous suspension.
Pass the suspension through a 70 μm filter.
Fill the falcon tube with PBS to 50 mL.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min.
Resuspend the pellet with appropriate volume of cold PBS to adjust cell concentration to 2×10^7 cells/mL.
Keep the cells on ice until injection.
Measure the longest dimension and perpendicular dimension of established tumors with a digital caliper.
Calculate the tumor surface using the formula: longest dimension (mm) × perpendicular dimension (mm) × π/4.
Randomize mice based on their tumor sizes and distribute into groups, including a vehicle control group and various DC groups.
Subject mice to isoflurane anesthesia in an anesthesia box with 2.5% concentration at a flow rate of 1.5 L/min.
Maintain the mouse under anesthesia using an anesthesia mask with the same flow rate on a heating pad set to 37°C.
Disinfect the tumor area with 70% ethanol followed by iodine.
Inject 50 μL of de-iniDC suspension or cold PBS into the tumor bed.
Repeat de-iniDC administration every 4 days until day 19, delivering a total of 4 intratumoral injections per animal.
Measure tumor size regularly to generate growth curves.
Euthanize mice with tumors exceeding 250 mm² or showing necrotic malignancies.
